original: 何で彼に怒ってるの？

en.text: Why are you angry with him?

original: 怒らないでね。

en.text: Don't get angry, OK?

original: 彼が怒ってるところ初めて見た。

en.text: This is the first time I've ever seen him angry.

original: あんなに怒ってるの見たの初めて。

en.text: I've never seen him so angry before.

original: 怒ると思った。

en.text: I knew you'd be mad.
I knew you'd be angry.
I thought you'd be angry.
I thought you'd be mad.

original: 彼女にめちゃ怒られるぞ。

en.text: Your girlfriend is going to be so mad at you.

original: 怒らないでね。分かった？

en.text: Don't get mad, OK?
